AI-driven image analysis enabled continuous monitoring of single-cell morphology, proliferation dynamics, and fluorescence-based metabolic activities. A lactate-tolerant mutant strain (designated S-3-4) was subsequently isolated using contact-free laser-induced bubble (LIB) ejection technology.
